items.reason: 상부 흰 사이드 컨트롤·하부 파란 raised-leg 소속과 두 사람의 연속 사지는 원본 대표 자세에 맞게 교정됐습니다. 명백한 추가 사지나 끊어진 관절은 확인하지 못했습니다. 다만 흰 앞전완 아래·파란 얼굴 오른쪽의 파란 소매와 접힌 파란 다리 윤곽이 합쳐져, 같은 파란 팔이 어느 자기 다리 고리를 통과해 닫히는지 정지 그림에서 확정하기 어렵습니다. 이는 비핵심 가림을 모두 드러내라는 요구가 아니라 버기를 구별하는 한 접점의 표현 불명확입니다.

The defining BLUE own-arm/own-leg closure remains visually ambiguous at one central junction; it is not promoted to PASS by inferring the hidden route.

Clarify ONLY the compact BLUE arm-to-own-leg junction directly beneath the WHITE near forearm/hand and immediately to the right of the BLUE face, approximately x=560–960, y=580–955 on this 1254-pixel square. Separate the EXISTING BLUE forearm/cuff contour from the adjacent bent BLUE leg with a small occlusion boundary or minimal local cloth-fold separation, so one existing blue arm can be followed into the same own-leg closure. Preserve the actual contact, hand locations, WHITE overlying forearm, faces, all four leg routes and full gi colors. Do not invent an exposed terminal grip, add a limb, reopen the compact loop, or reveal unrelated hidden anatomy.

revisionReviews.sourceLimit: The Ruotolo still itself naturally occludes terminal grip depth. This review does not demand that all hands, feet or grips be exposed; it does not assert the hidden anatomy is wrong. The only unresolved point is the technique-defining arm-through-own-leg connection.
revisionReviews.nextEditNotSpecifiedReason: No definite wrong connection or confidently reconstructable hidden hand route was found. Another near-identical contour-only instruction would repeat the unresolved v4 edit rather than add grounded information.

nextStepRecommendation.recommendation: If a further candidate is required, first identify a direct teaching still of this same buggy variant that distinguishes the own forearm from the bent own leg at this one junction. Then make only that grounded local connection readable while preserving current v5 whole-body geometry. Do not invent a grip or require exposure of unrelated hidden anatomy.
nextStepRecommendation.avoid: Do not commission another full pose or another identical contour-only edit solely because the prompt calls the existing enclosure correct.

revisionReviews.technicalPassMeaning: Static recognizable technique identity requires the defining closure to be readable without relying on the generation objective. This v5 remains unconfirmed, not proven anatomically invalid.

revisionReviews.reason: v6 실제 PNG에서는 파란 공격자의 소매·커프가 같은 파란 접힌 다리 안쪽으로 들어가는 경로를 따라갈 수 있고, 중앙의 피부/커프 틈과 서로 다른 천 윤곽으로 팔과 바지가 구분됩니다. v4·v5에서 흰 앞전완 아래 합쳐 보였던 한 접점이 이번에는 읽힙니다. 파란 바텀·흰 탑 배역과 전신 도복 소속이 일관되며, 보이는 범위에서 명백한 추가 사지·관절 단절·다른 사람 다리로 바뀐 폐쇄는 확인되지 않습니다. 이는 대표 OG 버기의 정지 기술 식별 PASS이며 가린 최종 손가락 그립이나 실제 조임 성공을 확인한 판정은 아닙니다.

This overall view is not an x-ray of every hand. No claim is made that all terminal grip depth or pressure effect is visible. The photographed top arm/camera may replace v5's obscuring support-arm position.

sourceComparison.note: The generated view is a near-side three-quarter illustration rather than a pixel match to the partnered photo. The new visible sleeve/own-leg hook is compared with the isolated teaching detail; camera or top support-arm differences are not used to infer hidden anatomy.
